motionChecks: Root visibly travels across the frame instead of only swaying in place.
Each travel beat has a short pause at the far end so Replay can isolate the peak frame.
Head, shoulders, hips, knees, and feet stay trackable through the travel window.
setupChecks: Leave enough floor space on both sides or front/back for a real root path.
Start centered far enough back that the full body remains visible at both ends.
Confirm Replay Lab start-gate labels do not show setup blockers before judging root travel.
stopIf: The body leaves frame at either end of travel.
The motion reads as weight shift only; no clear root path is visible.
Feet or hips are repeatedly hidden during the travel beat.
validationChecks: Run the quick validation alias immediately after import.
Expect root-travel amplitude to meet or exceed 0.160.
If validation fails, inspect the first failing frame in Replay Lab before trying another capture.

motionChecks: Head and shoulders move clearly toward the knees from a neutral seated start.
The fold is held briefly before returning to seated neutral.
Chair contact remains stable; the tester does not stand or slide out of the seat.
setupChecks: Keep the chair, hips, knees, feet, head, shoulders, and torso visible at the same time.
Start in a clean neutral seated pose before the first fold.
Confirm Replay Lab start-gate labels do not show missing chair/body setup before judging the fold.
stopIf: Chair contact is hidden or unstable.
The fold happens mostly as head nodding without shoulder/torso travel.
Feet, knees, or hips disappear during the fold.
validationChecks: Run the quick validation alias immediately after import.
Expect seated-forward-fold amplitude to be detected while chair contact remains stable.
If validation fails, inspect setup labels and the fold peak before trying another capture.
